hook: Hyderabad's AQI averaged *509* the night after Deepavali
hook_b: Hyderabad's AQI averaged *509* the night after Deepavali
tldr: Deepavali smoke kept Hyderabad's air at hazardous levels into Monday morning.

beats.what: The Hindu reports air quality worsened overnight, with PM2.5 at 392 µg/m³ at 9:30 pm and an average AQI of 509.
beats.why: Fireworks smoke settles when winds are weak. Hyderabad Mail reports IMD expects dry conditions from Nov 9 through the week.
beats.care: Check your area's AQI before outdoor runs or school drop-offs today.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: the air of Deepavali celebrations lingers in Hyderabad with AQI at hazardous levels. Hyderabad Mail: isolated rain on Nov 8, dry conditions forecast for the following week. Update (evening): Siasat reports Begumpet's AQI hit 828 as firecrackers choked Hyderabad on Diwali night.

cards.q: Did the smoke affect you last night?

qs: Diwali 2024's citywide AQI was 171. Is 509 a one-night overnight spike, or a new baseline for festival nights?
Which Hyderabad areas get the worst air when smoke settles?

facts.t: was Hyderabad's citywide AQI on *Diwali 2024*, against an acceptable limit of 60. New Malakpet hit 335.
PM2.5 peaked at *475* at the US Consulate monitor on Diwali 2024.

viz.verdict: Begumpet far above the city's hazardous average
No rain forecast to wash the smoke out
